pages.title: Steel From Another Age
pages.text: Turn expedition resources into a useful technology.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Make the blend from manganese, raw iron and silicate using its recipe, smelt it and take the output manually. Owning a gifted ingot does not complete this smelting task.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Acquire manganese from the Pleistocene and process it with raw iron and silicate into manganese steel blend; smelt to ingot. Material for cold-resistant armor and utility gear.
